task_cases.question: How did Steven's collecting become a store?
task_cases.query: Steven sweepstakes doubles hoarding laid off seven months company June 2008 Diamond Bar April
task_cases.speaker: Steven
task_cases.answer: Steven recalls a childhood $2,000 Toys R Us sweepstakes win that helped him get Atari 2600 and NES hardware, and says he kept his collection and packaging. Later duplicate-buying supplied inventory. After a layoff, a new job and seven months there, he left to vend; he gives June 2008 as his booth opening. He later opened Super Video Game Bros in Diamond Bar in April of the prior year—April 2015 relative to this January 2016 episode. These are his recollections, not independently audited dates.
